L43: Halo 3 Available on PC July 14
L44: 
L45: On July 14, Halo 3 joins Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC) on PC and will be available for download at 10am PT (UTC-7). To learn more about how you can get in on the action, click cite16†HERE†www.xbox.com . A breakdown of the new features, update size, and bug fixes can be found below:
L46: ## New Features
L47:   * (PC) Forge is now available for Halo: Reach, Halo 2: Anniversary, and Halo 3.
L48:   * Halo 3 Forge has been updated with new features, including Object Physics, rotation, coordinate snap and precision edit tools.
L49:   * Halo 3 and Halo: Reach Forge pallets have been expanded with new objects and budget increases.
L50:   * Halo 3, Halo: Reach, and Halo 2: Anniversary Forge tools have been updated with a new “Toggle Rotation Axes” feature adding toggleable rotation around World and Local axes. Note: This is planned to be added into Halo 4 at a later date.
L51:   * Updated season unlock flow to feature non-linear unlocks per page and added Season 2 featuring 30 new nameplates, 46 new H1 Weapon and 18 H1 Vehicle skins.
L52:   * Challenges are now available to complete across all available titles. Note: Campaign Challenges are currently not supported in Halo 4: Spartan Ops.
L53:   * New spartan customization 3D model viewer for Halo 3.
L54:   * Updated Skill Rank backend for Ranked Matchmaking. This resolved a long-standing rank reset issue and has required us reset all ranked playlists to 1.
L55:   * “Highest Lifetime” rank is now displayed for rotational hoppers that are no longer available.
L56:   * Halo: Reach & Halo 3 audio has been updated.
L57:   * New Acrophobia skull for Halo 3.
L58:   * “Dual Wield Inversion” has been added as a toggle for players who wish to disable the title from switching the “primary fire” weapon to your left-hand while dual wielding in Halo 2 or Halo 3.
L59: ## Game Install Size and Version
L60: 
L61: Please see the information below to ensure you have proper disk space to install each title from your desired store platform as well as are on the latest update.
L62: 
L63: Latest Version
L64: 
L65:   * The latest version of the game is 1.1698.0.0, to find the version number (cite17†Full KBA ).
L66:   * To update your game if you are not on the latest version (cite18†Full KBA ).
L67: 
L68: Microsoft Store and Xbox Game Pass for PC (Beta)
L69:   * MCC owners will receive a 20.84GB update with the full install being 93.15GB.
L70: 
L71: Steam
L72: 
L73:   * MCC Bundle Owners: A 17.6GB update with Halo: Reach, H:CEA, H2:A, and Halo 3 being about 124.5 installed.
L74: 
L75: Xbox
L76: 
L77:   * MCC will receive a 23.38GG update with the full install being 127.76
L78: ## Resolved Community Issues
L79: 
L80: Improvements have been across the board from our last update and previous flights. Below are several new game-specific features and resolved issues that come with today’s update and the platform (Xbox Only, PC Only, or All Platforms):
L81: 
L82: Global (All Platforms)
L83:   * Fixed issues where achievements for killing Engineers were displayed as ODST-specific despite being attainable in Halo: Reach as well.
L84:   * Fixed an issue where nameplate unlock criteria was no longer displayed once unlocked.
L85:   * Fixed various cases where the game client could crash during shutdown.
L86: 
L87:  Global (PC)
L88:   * Fixed an issue where the “He’s Running a Marathon”, “The Guardians are Coming” and “Why am I Here?” achievements would not unlock in Steam after unlocking them on Xbox Live.
L89:   * Fixed an issue where the campaign preview widget would appear on the root Main Menu after a sign-in change.
L90:   * Fixed a crash which could occur when entering the Seasonal Overview immediately after sign-in.
L91:   * Improved how the Seasonal Overview is displayed in non-standard aspect ratios.
L92: 
L93:  Global (Xbox)
L94:   * Fixed a crash which could occur when looking up certain Gamertags with the Find Player feature in the Roster.
L95: 
L96: Halo: Reach (All Platforms)
L97: 
L98:   * Audio has been updated with Waves integration, aligning closer to Xbox 360 quality.
L99:   * Fixed an issue where “Xbox 360” was referenced on the Boot Betrayer prompt in non-English languages.
L100:   * Added localization for map location names in non-English languages.
L101:   * Fixed an issue where the wrong key was displayed on the Boot Betrayer prompt.
L102: Halo: Combat Evolved (All Platforms)
L103:   * New Customization Support for Halo: Combat Evolved Multiplayer, including Visor, Vehicle, and Weapon Skins.
L104:   * “New Skins” can be disabled under the “Gameplay” submenu in settings to locally return H1’s appearance to legacy.
L105:   * Fixed an issue where spamming the plasma pistol’s trigger would cause the charge-up sound to stick.
L106:   * Rocket Warthog can now be manually reloaded.
L107:   * Fixed an issue where some starting weapons were not respected on Rat Race.
L108:   * Gameplay audio should no longer be heard in the background while a terminal plays in Co-Op Campaign.
L109: Halo 2 (All Platforms)
L110:   * Resolved a crash that could occur during long playthroughs.
L111:   * Enemy Elites now dual wield.
L112:   * Fixed an issue where the Energy Sword displayed incorrectly when viewed against flood tanks in “The Oracle.”
L113:   * Rebuilt the lightmap for the initial classic cinematic on “Outskirts” to return lighting and shadows to OG Xbox visuals.
L114:   * Adjusted a default gamma option to bring it closer to OG Xbox. This may result in lighting and brightness looking different then our past patch.
L115:   * Fixed an issue that was causing players in matchmade games to grenade jump higher than expected, bringing the height back down to OG Xbox clients.
L116:   * Fixed an issue where the “Malfunction” skull would display HUD elements incorrectly while dual wielding.
L117:   * Infinite ammo and grenades now display with the “infinity” symbol in the HUD.
L118:   * Fixed an issue where a controller would sometimes be stuck vibrating after coming out of gameplay.
L119:   * Resolved a loading issue that would cause Campaign Co-Op Players to disconnect when starting a mission.
L120:   * Horizontal mouse movement while on a stationary turret is now unbound and no longer restricted by the turning radius.
L121:   * Fixed an issue where some dynamic music tracks in Campaign Classic Mode was looping incorrectly.
L122: Halo 2: Anniversary (All Platforms)
L123: 
L124:   * Fixed an issue where the sentinel beam VFX would occasionally not display.
L125:   * Added 0% option for fall damage in Custom Games.
L126:   * Players can now move while the Scoreboard is open.
L127: 
L128: Halo 3 (All Platforms)
L129:   * Audio has been updated with Waves integration, aligning closer to Xbox 360 quality.
L130:   * Several matte paintings have been updated with higher fidelity versions in Campaign cinematics.
L131:   * Customization has been updated to support individual armor pieces and tertiary colors.
L132:   * Emblems now display on armor in gameplay.
L133:   * Footsteps in the snow no longer appear with black textures.
L134:   * Fixed some incorrectly lit particles when Scarabs or Phantoms were destroyed.
L135:   * Hornet and Brute Chopper turning speed has been improved to better match Xbox 360.
L136:   * Added the Fuel Rod Gun, Sentinel Beam, Carbine, Mauler, and Plasma Rifle as starting weapons to Custom Games.
L137:   * Fixed an issue where the prowler was misrepresented as the mauler in tools of destruction on the Post Game Carnage Report.
L138:   * Fixed issues where some strings extended outside of the gametype objective widget in non-English languages.

L43: MCC Update on September 22, 2020
L44: To da y, September 22, 2020, we are releasing Halo 3: ODST for the PC. This will include an update for the Xbox version that includes Firefight for ODST. We are also happy to in troduce the beginning of Season 3 which will incorporate customization unlocks for titles in the collection a long with a journey of continued challenges to complete. A breakdown of the install and update sizes and bug fixes can be found below:
L45: 
L46: Game Install Size and Version
L47: Please see the information below to ensure you have the proper disk space to install the latest update.
L48: 
L49: Latest Version
L50: 
L51:   * The latest version of the game is 1.1 829.0.0, to find the version number (cite16†Full KBA ).
L52:   * To update your game if you are not on the latest version (cite17†Full KBA ).
L53: 
L54: Microsoft Store and Xbox Game Pass for PC (Beta)
L55: 
L56:   * Max size of 14.09 GB
L57: 
L58: Steam
L59: 
L60:   * Max size of 11.5 G B
L61: 
L62: Xbox
L63: 
L64:   * Max size of 19.74 GB
L65: 
L66: New Features
L67:   * ODST is now available on PC!
L68:   * ODST Firefight has been added to Xbox, Steam, and Windows Store, included with the ODST DLC package.
L69:   * ODST Firefight now supports custom game variant options for creating your own Firefight modes.
L70:   * Season 3 has been added to the collection, featuring ODST Firefight Customization, New Halo 3 Weapon and Visor Skins, and new nameplates including:
L71:     * 12 Halo 3 Weapon Skins.
L72:     * 30 Halo 3 Visor Skins.
L73:     * 10 ODST Character Skins.
L74:     * 4 ODST Character Skins (Unlockable via Challenges).
L75:     * 30 Nameplates.
L76:   * A new frontend menu has been added to welcome ODST Firefight Customization to the collection.
L77:   * Halo 2 Anniversary Multiplayer’s Customization has been broken down into per-part pieces.
L78:   * Added Challenges to the Pause Menu for visibility during gameplay.
L79:   * Added an option that allows users to disable the Challenge notification.
L80:   * Added deck progress counter in Challenge Hub.
L81:   * Progress notifications for featured (golden) challenges now appear gold.
L82:   * More variety is present for Challenges which reward Season Points from week to week.
L83:   * Added ODST's Silenced SMG, Automag, and Brute Plasma Rifle to Halo 3 Multiplayer.
L84:   * Added Recon weapon set to override all weapons on the map with their ODST counterparts.
L85:   * Added new option for Halo 3 Grenade Regeneration which includes Firebomb grenades.
L86:   * Added bottomless clip option for Halo 3 Infinite Ammo setting.
L87:   * Simplified Chinese Text Language is now supported in ODST.
L88: Flight Improvements Brought into MCC Retail
L89: 
L90: These improvements came from feedback reported by our community and were resolved during or after the flight period of ODST. Thank you for participating!
L91: 
L92: Halo 3
L93:   * We have brought over the improvements made in our last flight patch to hit registration in multiplayer (related to the 60hz and 30hz engine refresh rate as referenced in our development July 2020 blog).
L94:   * Fixed several issues that caused floating turrets, mongoose falling from the sky, and a series of issues that were identified during the initial flight with Elephants on Sandtrap.
L95:   * Service ID's shorter than 3 characters now  display  in gameplay.
L96:   * Scoreboard player scrolling is now bound to Up and Down arrow keys.
L97:   * Updated how the camera intersects with objects in Forge fixing an issue where players would be flung out of the map boundaries and killed when playing or moving objects.
L98:   * Several improvements to Forge with camera movement, menu navigation, and placing or moving objects.
L99:   * Halo 3 matchmaking game films no longer prevent players from restarting the film.
L100: ODST
L101:   * Fixed a n issue that caused missing or delayed subtitles during cutscenes.
L102:   * Detached turrets no longer use lowered crosshairs when Crosshair Position is set to “Centered”.
L103:   * Players can operate and exit hijacked Ghosts without others seeing them as standing on it.
L104:   * Resolved several crash issues reported during the flight period.
L105:   * All the character models have matching hands.
L106:   * AA Wraith Spawns normally in “Lost Platoon.”
L107:   * Suicide Grunts now have grenades in their hands.
L108:   * Projectiles are visible when Wraiths are seen firing.
L109:   * Players can use health packs in Firefight. Scope zoom sound effects only play once in Firefight.
L110:   * When the time limit expires the game ends instead of a new game starting before the end of the current game in Firefight.
L111:   * Fron t turrets on Phantoms are visible to players  in Firefight
L112:   * The preview images were corrected for several reward tiers (Romeo and Buck, Helmets on/off).
L113: Resolved Issues
L114:

L123:   * "Playlist stats" is no longer missing "Max local players" in the "Competitive" game mode selection menu.
L124:   * The warning when enabling a zero-scoring skull has been updated to define that any "mission completion, scoring, time, Challenges, and par achievements will not be recorded when running campaign with a zero-scoring skull.
